Autonomous AI Security Auditor

scheduled scans, and CloudTrail analysis to detect policy misconfigurations, insecure prompts, data-leak risks, and adversarial

outputs. Designed a modular evaluation pipeline using CrewAI and FastAPI, improved reliability over traditional assessment methods.
